item.tib: dri med rnam dag phyi yi rgyud / 'jig rten spyod pa'i dpal gyi mgon / bdun cu rtsa lnga'i yang snying gzungs / 'gro kun phan bde legs bshad
item.coloph: bsngo ba legs bshad kyis mthar rgyan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o // phyi bar gsang gsum gzungs kyi don bsdus pa 'di yang / sngon chad gong ma bru ston rgyal ba dang / bar du skyabs ston rin chen 'od zer [illeg.] / gzungs ma tshangs kha sk[o]ngs nyung 'dus 'di / zhu yi rgyud 'dzin ku su lo ba yis / dri med lhan skyes sgrub pa'i thun 'tshams su / gnas mchog skyid mkhar stod phug brag nang du / mdo rgyud dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde dang / mdo gzungs 'phran bu mang po'i nang nas bsdus …
item.note: the appended folio has no title and no marginal title or folio number marked on it. it is in fact a continuation of the colophons [or rather an added colophon about the making of the particular manuscript] to the text that precedes it, although it is difficult to read. following a rather long prayer, we may make out the significant words, on p. 590v4: 'di bris drung ming rab wer klu phyug nga / drin skyong [illeg…] stobs shugs kyis / bris 'don klong gsum… [illeg.] rang lo bdun cu rtsa lnga len dus na / shi … also on p. 590v4, the date fire monkey may be seen, and this is the date of completion of the manuscript copy (this could correspond to 1836, 1896, or 1956).
